source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; echo "===== MainPre1 (haves+m, no bmc) ====="; timeout 500 lake build Book1.Prop47.MainPre1 > /tmp/mp1.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -iE "MainPre1.lean:|error|unsolved" /tmp/mp1.log | grep -vE "Prop[0-9]+/(Main|step)|sorry" | head; echo "===== MainPre (through bmc) ====="; timeout 700 lake build Book1.Prop47.MainPre > /tmp/mpb.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -iE "MainPre.lean:|error|unsolved" /tmp/mpb.log | grep -vE "Prop[0-9]+/(Main|step)|sorry" | head; echo ALLDONE
